course_description: Study of fundamental data structures, recursive algorithms, dynamic memory, sorting, trees, and algorithmic complexity.

course_outcomes.co_description: Implement recursive algorithms using fundamental data structures to solve computational problems.
Analyze the time and space complexity of various sorting algorithms to determine optimal performance for specific datasets.
Design balanced binary trees and implement traversal operations for efficient data retrieval and storage.
Configure dynamic memory allocation strategies to optimize resource utilization in complex applications.
Synthesize complex algorithmic solutions by integrating sorting, searching, and tree-based data structures.
